critique_summary: The verification plan omits an explicit old-writer versus new-writer race case.
reasoning_summary: The approved solution requires mixed-version compatibility and cross-node uniqueness, but the named verification item does not explicitly prove an old writer racing with a new writer. This is a plan completeness defect, not a new semantic decision.
supporting_findings: Mixed-version deployment is part of the approved migration strategy.
Old-writer bypass is an identified residual risk.
falsification_conditions: TST-010 already defines and executes the exact old-writer/new-writer race case.
